g.text: Dual-level chute and shaft return: one section
Nominal geometry and ideal head only; common shaft blockage remains a failure
Blue: sealed lower conduit. Green: upper open trough with horizontal +6382 side top.
Return at y5350/+6320 leads into shaft. Brown: existing midrail crossing, not a sealed sleeve design.
Q = 3.60375 L/s per stressed branch; ideal return head 34.93 mm is not capacity or freeboard acceptance.
